frozen_before: any LAB-08 arm run. scripts/audit_lab08.py checks the ordering.
immutable: this file is never overwritten. Re-running the freeze script prints the existing stamp and exits. A protocol that can be rewritten after a result is not frozen (guide L08.1)
evaluation_interval: daily UTC on the continuous account (guide 10.3)

seeds.rule: every seed is fixed here; a seed chosen later is a search decision

primary_matrix.reporting_rule: all 20 cell statuses are reported. A NOT_READY cell keeps null metrics and stays in the denominator; it is never dropped and never recorded as a PnL of 0 (guide 10.4)

arms.A: installed WFO selector, frozen calendar — the baseline
arms.B: neighborhood selector, same calendar — the robustness contribution
arms.C: installed selector, regime-triggered refresh — the timing contribution
arms.D: neighborhood selector, regime-triggered refresh — the interaction
arms.E: selector + bank + response policy — an EXTENSION, not a substitute for C or D

arm_e_rule: E is compared against B and against BANK_CALENDAR. Using E in place of C or D without saying so is forbidden (guide 10.1)

controls.RISK_ONLY: same regime context, risk scaling only, parameters unchanged
controls.CALENDAR_MATCHED: calendar cadence with compute equivalent to the dynamic policy
controls.BANK_CALENDAR: same bank size and candidate identities, calendar switching, no regime
controls.STATE_PLACEBO: fake labels with approximately the real dwell and switch frequency, generated from the past only
controls.DELAYED_STATE: one registered observation of extra delay, for transition sensitivity
controls.EXPOST_DIAGNOSTIC: hindsight labels, diagnostic only, never an eligible trade result
controls.USER_PRESET_REFERENCE: the supplied full-sample presets, labelled retrospective

control_rule: no control is dropped because it beats the proposed method. Controls are staged rather than run as a full Cartesian product (guide 10.2)

economics.source: configs/study_registration.json execution block, frozen at LAB-01
economics.rule: fees, slippage, funding treatment and gross exposure constraints are the same for every arm and every control (guide 10.3)

account_rule: each arm holds ONE continuous account in chronological order. No reset at a fold or regime boundary, and no splicing of segments from independent runs (guide 10.3, T56)

outer_evaluation.contamination: NOT an untouched holdout: the supplied presets were TPE-tuned on the full sample with an unknown cutoff

contamination.reason: supplied presets were TPE-tuned on the full sample and the tuning cutoff is unknown, so no interval of this dataset can be called an untouched holdout

primary_endpoint.statistic: mean daily net-return difference between arms on the same risk budget
primary_endpoint.aggregation: daily UTC paired differences on a common evaluation interval

minimum_economic_effect.definition: the smallest mean daily net-return difference the lab will call economically meaningful for the primary endpoint
minimum_economic_effect.rule: an improvement smaller than this sits inside the registered cost-stress band and is reported as inconclusive, not as an edge. The threshold is fixed now, before any arm has been compared, so it can never be chosen to fit an observed delta (guide 11.2).
minimum_economic_effect.turnover_source: market qualification on development slices; a smoke measurement, not a performance claim

compute_budget.rule: no arm gets more CPU than the registered budget in order to finish before the baseline (guide L08.6)

exit_rule: profit is not required to close discovery, and a negative result is not a technical failure to be re-run until it wins (guide L08 exit)
